title: [main] Line Discount Amount Rounding Discrepancy When Transferring Project Planning Lines to Sales Invoice
summary: Line Discount Amount is now correctly preserved when transferring project planning lines to a sales invoice, eliminating rounding discrepancies caused by recalculation from the rounded percentage.
key_points: Fixed rounding discrepancy where line discount amount was recalculated from rounded percentage instead of preserving the original value
After percentage validation, the exact line discount amount from the planning line is now transferred to the sales line
Handles partial invoicing and credit memos through quantity ratio calculation
Converts discount amount to invoice currency when needed
Added test case validating that discount amount remains accurate through the transfer process
quote: Line Discount Amount rounding discrepancy when transferring Project Planning Lines to a Sales Invoice.
